title: Memory
subtitle: Your library of collections. Search any of them here, or add one to an agent when you want it used.

actions.resetCollection: Remove every entry, keep the collection

empty.title: Memory holds documents an agent can search
empty.text: A collection is a set of files and web pages, indexed so that a question finds the passages that answer it. You can search it here without any agent.
empty.stepFill: Add files or a web page to it.
empty.stepAsk: Ask it a question to see what comes back, then give it to an agent.

deleteDialog.title: Delete Collection
deleteDialog.message: Delete collection "{{name}}"? This will remove all entries and cannot be undone.

resetDialog.title: Remove every entry
resetDialog.message: Remove every entry from collection "{{name}}"? The collection stays. This cannot be undone.

pane.pick: Pick a collection to search it, add to it, or see who uses it.

ask.title: Try a question
ask.label: Ask this collection a question
ask.alone: Runs on this collection alone. No chat, model or agent is involved.
ask.none: Nothing came back for that question.

sources.title: Web sources
sources.none: No web sources. Add a URL to keep a page or feed in this collection.

entries.title: Files
entries.none: No files yet. Add a file or a web page to fill this collection.
entries.failed: Part of this collection could not be read.

removeSource.title: Remove Source
removeSource.message: Remove this source? What it added stays until you delete the entry.

deleteEntry.title: Delete Entry
deleteEntry.message: Are you sure you want to delete this entry?

api.title: Index, API and privacy
api.index: Files are split into passages and indexed when they are added. A question is matched to passages by similarity, and each passage comes back with a score.
api.privacy: Files you upload stay on this server. A web source is fetched from the address you give, on the interval you set.
